decks.notes: This deck focuses on fast mana generation and devotion to green to enable powerful ramp and aggression. It utilizes cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to accelerate mana, while Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx enhances devotion to green. Oath of Nissa helps with card selection, while Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provides an aggressive threat. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Cavalier of Thorns offer additional ramp and card advantage. Karn, the Great Creator has utility to find artifacts, and Lovestruck Beast provides extra aggression. Storm the Festival is a powerful card to generate multiple creatures. Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility.

This deck is focused on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels early in the game. It also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Secrets of the Key to generate value and card advantage. The deck includes various utility spells like Impulse','','');">Fiery Impulse and Spell Pierce to control the board, as well as lands like Mutavault and Riverglide Pathway for mana fixing. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with big threats and creative plays.

This deck focuses on controlling the board using a combination of removal spells, enchantments, and creatures that interact with Enigmatic Incarnation. The goal is to set up Enigmatic Incarnation to cheat out powerful creatures from the deck while maintaining control of the game through removal and card advantage from Yorion, Sky Nomad. The deck also includes a variety of versatile creatures to adapt to different situations and a mix of lands to support its diverse color requirements.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to play efficiently costed creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with powerful burn spells like Play with Fire and Atarka's Command to deal damage directly to your opponent. By using cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to pump up your creatures, you can quickly close out the game before your opponent has a chance to stabilize. The deck's mana base is designed to ensure you can consistently play your threats on curve and apply maximum pressure.

This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around green devotion. By utilizing mana acceleration from Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, along with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck can quickly ramp into powerful threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator provides additional versatility and disruption, while cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner help maintain card advantage and board presence. The deck also includes utility lands like Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures to support its game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain tempo and aggressiveness by utilizing Azorius Spirits to control the board while also dealing damage efficiently. By playing aggressively with cards like Rattlechains and Shacklegeist, the deck aims to control the game by countering opponent's spells and protecting its own creatures with counterspells like Lofty Denial. The inclusion of cards like Curious Obsession and Spectral Sailor help maintain card advantage and provide additional options for damage. Overall, the deck relies on its ability to control the game tempo and chip away at the opponent's life total with its aggressive Spirit creatures.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and control the board. The key strategy is to apply early pressure with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The inclusion of Haunted Ridge and Bloodtithe Harvester helps to maintain a steady stream of threats, with additional reach provided by cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Reckoner Bankbuster. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse serves as a powerful finisher to seal the deal.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, along with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also features graveyard synergy with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to provide additional value and resilience. With a mix of efficient removal and strong creatures, this deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out games quickly.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to control the game by countering spells, removing threats, and generating card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck focuses on staying alive with counterspells like Absorb and Dovin's Veto, board wipes like Supreme Verdict, and land disruption with Field of Ruin. The win condition is typically through a combination of creating large Shark tokens with Shark Typhoon, attacking with Hall of Storm Giants, and eventually closing out the game with powerful spells like The Wandering Emperor.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes and then bring them back to the battlefield for a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck focuses on using spells like Fiery Impulse, Lightning Axe, and Opt to put Arclight Phoenix in the graveyard, then using spells like Treasure Cruise, Pieces of the Puzzle, and Temporal Trespass to bring them back for repeated attacks. The inclusion of Thing in the Ice helps control the board and protect the Phoenixes, while cards like Izzet Charm and Spell Pierce provide additional utility and protection.

The deck focuses on utilizing greaecefang Parhelion's ability to create lifelink tokens that can be sacrificed for various effects, such as drawing cards or gaining life. By utilizing cards like Grisly Salvage, Satyr Wayfinder, and Stitcher's Supplier to fill the graveyard, the deck can efficiently bring out the combo pieces like Parhelion II and Can't Stay Away. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughseize and Raffine's Informant to control the game and ensure the combo can be executed smoothly.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand through counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes, while also generating card advantage and value through card draw and planeswalkers. It aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently answering their threats and gradually gaining control of the game. The deck's win conditions include resolving powerful threats like Shark Typhoon, Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, and The Wandering Emperor to close out the game. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes utility lands like Castle Vantress and Field of Ruin to deal with problematic permanents.

The main concept of this Golgari Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells in order to quickly deplete their life total. By utilizing cards like Collected Company to quickly put threats on the board, and sacrificing creatures for value with cards like Priest of Forgotten Gods and Woe Strider, the deck aims to outpace and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds consistency and an additional threat to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out high-cost creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels early in the game. It also utilizes a variety of spells like Impulse','','');">Fiery Impulse and Fire Prophecy to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Shark Typhoon and Secrets of the Key adds versatility and card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and creative plays, while also maintaining control over the game with its removal and counter spells.

This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang, Parhelion combo by utilizing cards like Eldritch Evolution and Satyr Wayfinder to search for and play key pieces like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's game plan. Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provides additional removal and pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to create a powerful board state with multiple threats and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of combo pieces and controlling elements.

This deck focuses on combining cards like Indomitable Creativity and Worldspine Wurm to cheat out powerful threats onto the battlefield. It also utilizes cards like Xenagos, God of Revels and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to pump up its creatures and close out the game quickly. The deck includes various ways to control the board with cards like Shark Typhoon and Impulse','','');">Fiery Impulse, while also incorporating counter spells like Negate and Spell Pierce for protection. Overall, the deck aims to surprise opponents with its unique combo strategy and overwhelming power.
